notes: Restraint-only. Personal finance 28->12: Personal Capital merged into Empower Personal Dashboard; Mint dropped (discontinued); minor and regional duplicates dropped. Tax software 46->11 consumer products: tax-professional suites dropped per brief (Intuit ProConnect/ProSeries, ProFile, TaxTron Professional, DT MAX, Onvio, UFile Pro, ATX, CCH iFirm, TaxCycle, Drake, TaxAct/TaxSlayer Professional), Credit Karma Tax (now Cash App Taxes) and minor German titles dropped. Accounting 74->10 freelancer/small-business products: enterprise and ERP suites dropped (QuickBooks Enterprise, Apache OFBiz, Dynamics, NetSuite, Oracle, Sage 300/Intacct/Enterprise Management, Acumatica, Odoo, ERPNext etc.); old ranges dropped. Gap noticed: Xero and Wave are absent from the old data and were not added (needs web pass). Time-tracking 8->5: staff-monitoring ActivTrak and Time Doctor and enterprise Replicon dropped per brief. Survey and form 39->12 (dropped enterprise experience-management tools such as Qualtrics, Alchemer, Satmetrix). No new kinds.
